channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: New British drone helicopter takes first flight
item.description: British aviation history was made this week as Leonardo's Proteus, the UK’s first truly autonomous full-size helicopter, completed its maiden flight from Predannack airfield on the Lizard Peninsula. The post New British drone helicopter takes first flight first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO chief to meet Danish and Greenland ministers
item.description: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte is scheduled to meet Denmark’s Minister of Defence, Troels Lund Poulsen, and Greenland’s Minister for Foreign Affairs and Research, Vivian Motzfeldt, at NATO Headquarters in Brussels on Monday. The post NATO chief to meet Danish and Greenland ministers first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Alexander welcomes Armed Forces Bill housing reforms
item.description: Scottish Secretary Douglas Alexander has said the Armed Forces Bill marks a decisive step in renewing the UK’s contract with service personnel, as new legislation promises a major upgrade to military housing across Scotland. The post Alexander welcomes Armed Forces Bill housing reforms first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy plans jet-powered autonomous carrier drone
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed the scope of Project Vanquish, a Royal Navy initiative exploring a carrier-capable autonomous fixed-wing aircraft, in response to a written parliamentary question. The post Royal Navy plans jet-powered autonomous carrier drone first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: The Vietnamese-run spam network promoting Nigel Farage
item.description: Investigation - A self-described UK news page promoting Nigel Farage has used viral storytelling, opaque advertising, and off-platform links to amplify political content. It should be noted no link has been identified to Farage or Reform UK. The post The Vietnamese-run spam network promoting Nigel Farage first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Paul Sweeney warns delays threaten Scottish shipbuilding
item.description: Paul Sweeney MSP has warned that delays to Scottish Government vessel procurement risk leaving publicly owned shipyards without sufficient work, arguing that the absence of a joined-up industrial strategy is undermining shipbuilding capacity in Scotland. The post Paul Sweeney warns delays threaten Scottish shipbuilding first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy confirms nine nuclear subs in service
item.description: The Royal Navy currently has nine nuclear-powered submarines in service, including four nuclear-armed vessels maintaining the UK’s continuous at-sea deterrent, the Ministry of Defence has confirmed. The post Royal Navy confirms nine nuclear subs in service first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK appoints new Military Representative to NATO and EU
item.description: Lieutenant General Eldon Millar CVO MBE has been appointed as the United Kingdom’s next Military Representative to NATO and the European Union. The post UK appoints new Military Representative to NATO and EU first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO intercepts Russian jets over the Baltic
item.description: Italian Eurofighters in Estonia were scrambled at around 11:30 today to intercept a Russian Beriev Be-200 aircraft. The post NATO intercepts Russian jets over the Baltic first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK warns Scottish independence would weaken Arctic security
item.description: Ministers have warned that Scottish independence would weaken UK and NATO security in the North Atlantic and Arctic, amid growing concern over Russian and Chinese activity in the High North. The post UK warns Scottish independence would weaken Arctic security first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
